title: Apollo 11: Humanity's First Moon Landing
description: Launch from Kennedy Space Center Pad 39A, insert into Low Earth Parking Orbit (185 x 185 km), perform Trans-Lunar Injection (TLI), execute Lunar Orbit Insertion (LOI), descend to the Sea of Tranquility, and return safely to Earth.

primaryObjectives.title: Execute Trans-Lunar Injection (TLI)
primaryObjectives.description: Perform translunar burn with delta-v of ~3.05 km/s to establish free-return lunar transfer trajectory.

primaryObjectives.title: Lunar Orbit Insertion (LOI)
primaryObjectives.description: Ignite the Service Propulsion System (SPS) retrograde burn behind the Moon to enter stable lunar orbit.

primaryObjectives.title: Lunar Module Touchdown
primaryObjectives.description: Execute powered descent burn with LM DPS to land at Mare Tranquillitatis.

secondaryObjectives.title: Preserve Fuel Margin
secondaryObjectives.description: Maintain at least 5% propellant reserves upon landing.
